## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      7 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 14 мар. 2026 г. - 2 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _mattallsop_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
            2. ___Mari__, 19 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            3. _Donotwasteyourtime84_, 30 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "Disappointing free trial experience. My trial was supposed to run through September 30th, but on the 30th itself my credits were already gone when I went to book a class. Earlier, the app glitched while I was trying to book a last minute class and support's only advice was to reinstall the app, which wasn't the issue and just wasted more of my time. I ended up canceling. The idea is great, but the app reliability, support, and unclear trial cutoff made it not worth continuing."
